newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-SCHALKE SQUEEZE THROUGH AFTER SIX-GOAL THRILLER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCHALKE SQUEEZE THROUGH AFTER SIX-GOAL THRILLER.

text.p: Schalke 04 of Germany reached the third round of the UEFA Cup by beating Trabzonspor 4-3 on aggregate after drawing 3-3 in the second leg of their second round tie on Tuesday.
Already a goal ahead from the first leg, Schalke established a 3-0 aggregate lead by the 36th minute with two headers inside four minutes by Dutchman Johan de Kock.
But Trabzonspor, inspired by a passionate 25,000 crowd, battled back to lead with goals from Sota Aveladze in the 55th minute and two strikes from Hami Mandirali in the 65th and 70th minutes.
That made the aggregate score 3-3, but Schalke were still in the driving seat courtesy of their two away goals.
But with 15 minutes to play, Martin Max, who scored Schalke's goal in the first leg, scored again to ensure Schalke's name goes into the hat for Friday's third round draw in Geneva.
